name: Imperial Jade Cascade Necklace
description: A majestic bib necklace featuring eleven hand-carved nephrite jade plaques suspended from layered gold chains. The collar is adorned with intricate filigree work and a central pagoda motif flanked by mythical creatures, evoking the grandeur of imperial Chinese craftsmanship.

name: Molten Flow Pendant Necklace
description: An avant-garde statement necklace featuring a dramatic draping pendant of organically flowing gold strands with lattice-like perforations. The sculptural centerpiece evokes molten metal in motion, suspended from a hand-forged link chain.

name: Phoenix Jade Chandelier Earrings
description: Elaborate drop earrings featuring a sculpted phoenix hook suspending a gold-framed nephrite jade plaque engraved with ancient taotie motifs. A tiered fringe of chains, gold beads, and jade pendants cascades below, blending dynastic Chinese symbolism with fine jewelry artistry.

name: Imperial Jade Cuff Bracelet
description: A wide cuff bracelet composed of smooth nephrite jade panels set within an ornate gold framework of Greek-key borders and a central taotie mask motif. The inner band carries repeating geometric fretwork, reflecting the architectural splendor of imperial Chinese palace design.

name: Art Deco Sapphire & Ruby Tower Earrings
materials: 18K Rose Gold, Blue Sapphire, Ruby, Diamond Baguettes
description: Striking Art Deco drop earrings with a tiered architectural silhouette. Each piece features a step-cut blue sapphire stud atop a trapezoidal pendant framed by calibré-set rubies and diamond baguettes, capturing the bold geometry and opulent color contrasts of the 1920s.

name: Duality Edge Cuff
materials: White Gold, Black Ceramic, Pavé Diamonds
description: A sleek open-cuff bracelet with a razor-sharp faceted profile that transitions seamlessly from polished white metal with black ceramic inlay on one side to a pavé diamond-encrusted arc on the other — a study in contrasts between raw precision and luminous luxury.

name: Lace Lattice Elongated Ring
description: A sculptural statement ring extending well beyond the finger with an open, reticulated structure inspired by organic cellular forms. The freeform lattice of flowing gold threads creates a dramatic, armor-like piece that blurs the boundary between jewelry and wearable sculpture.

name: Art Deco Ruby & Sapphire Panel Bracelet
materials: 18K Yellow Gold, Ruby, Blue Sapphire, Square-Cut Diamonds
description: A wide Art Deco bracelet with a grid of alternating ruby and sapphire columns set within a milgrain-edged gold framework. Square-cut diamonds punctuate the intersections, creating a bold rhythmic pattern reminiscent of stained-glass windows in a jazz-age skyscraper.

name: Art Deco Chevron Signet Ring
description: A substantial Art Deco signet ring featuring a multi-tiered face inlaid with chevron-patterned blue sapphires bordered by calibré-set rubies. The stepped pyramid profile and filigree-engraved shoulders evoke the bold symmetry and chromatic richness of 1920s decorative arts.

name: Voronoi Cuff Bracelet
description: A bold wide cuff bracelet with a richly textured Voronoi-inspired surface — an organic network of irregular cells and perforations that catches light from every angle. Handcrafted in warm gold, the piece evokes natural cellular structures like coral or bone, rendered in liquid metal.

name: Cascade Lattice Drop Earrings
description: Long, fluid drop earrings composed of an open gold lattice that narrows and drips into a pointed tapered end. The honeycombed perforations and undulating silhouette give the impression of suspended liquid metal, merging organic form with artisanal goldsmithing.

name: Minimalist Diamond Bar Bracelet
description: An elegant linear bracelet composed of three faceted rose gold bar segments connected by princess-cut diamond stations. The understated geometric design balances architectural restraint with delicate brilliance, making it an ideal everyday fine jewelry piece.

name: Pavilion Gate Jade Ring
description: An extraordinary statement ring featuring a nephrite jade centerpiece framed within a gold architectural surround modeled after a classical Chinese pavilion gate. Flanking panels are filled with scrolling cloud and ruyi motifs in deep relief, creating a wearable monument to traditional Chinese heritage architecture.

name: Baguette Diamond Bar Necklace
description: A refined and architectural bar necklace with a full row of channel-set baguette diamonds spanning a clean horizontal pendant. The sleek rose gold setting and geometric precision create a minimalist modern aesthetic with understated luminosity.

name: Soleil Yin-Yang Art Deco Necklace
materials: 18K Yellow Gold, Blue Sapphire, Ruby, Diamond Baguettes, Black Onyx
description: A spectacular Art Deco statement necklace centered on a sunburst medallion with a yin-yang core of pear-cut rubies and sapphires. Radiating fan-shaped spokes of black onyx, baguette diamonds, and calibré-set gemstones surround the central motif, while a geometric chain of sapphires, rubies, and diamonds completes the composition.

name: Geometric Tension-Set Diamond Ring
description: A bold architectural ring with a flat trapezoidal top panel tension-set with a single emerald-cut diamond. The angular, wing-like profile and mirror-polished white metal surface give this piece a futuristic, sculptural presence — where precision engineering meets fine gem-setting.
